newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain shares spend subdued week in tight range.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain shares spend subdued week in tight range.

text.p: Bahrain shares were little changed in the week to Wednesday in sharply lower volume trade, the Bahrain Stock Exchange said.
It said the index crept up to 1,586.03 points from 1,579.89 points at the end of last week's trade.
The trading week was shortened by Thursday's new hijra year holiday, when the bourse will be closed.

Around 5.74 million shares worth 1.2 million dinars ($3.2 million) changed hands, down from 12.4 million shares worth 2.7 million dinars last week. Shares of 22 of the 39 registered were traded in 147 transactions.
Activity focused on the banking and investment sector, where stocks worth 710,449 dinars were traded.

Investcorp was the week's most active stock with shares worth 266,734 dinars dealt. It closed at $1.79. Al-Ahli Commercial Bank came next with shares worth 167,878 dinars traded. It closed two fils lower at 342 fils.
Bahrain Middle East Bank was unchanged at 99 fils.

Bahrain's market is open to nationals of the six Gulf Arab states - Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Oman and Kuwait. Some firms are also open to foreign investors. ($1 = 0.377 dinar)
